title: Identify the cities in counties with the highest number of closed schools t
question: Identify the cities in counties with the highest number of closed schools that also have at least one active District Community Day School, and return the free meal eligibility rate for students aged 5–17 in those cities.

prediction.sql:
WITH closed_counts AS (
  SELECT "XCL_045" AS county, COUNT(*) AS closed_count
  FROM schools
  WHERE "XCL_044" = 'Closed'
  GROUP BY "XCL_045"
),
top_county AS (
  SELECT county FROM closed_counts ORDER BY closed_count DESC LIMIT 1
),
qualifying_cities AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s."XCL_050" AS city
  FROM schools s
  WHERE s."XCL_045" = (SELECT county FROM top_county)
    AND s."XCL_044" = 'Active'
    AND s."XCL_069" = 'District Community Day School'
)
SELECT s."XCL_050" AS city,
       CAST(SUM(f."XCL_025") AS REAL) / SUM(f."XCL_024") AS free_meal_eligibility_rate
FROM frpm f
INNER JOIN schools s ON f."XCL_001" = s."XCL_041"
WHERE s."XCL_050" IN (SELECT city FROM qualifying_cities)
GROUP BY s."XCL_050"

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
WITH closed_counts AS (
  SELECT "XCL_045" AS county, COUNT(*) AS closed_count
  FROM schools
  WHERE "XCL_044" = 'Closed'
  GROUP BY "XCL_045"
),
top_county AS (
  SELECT county FROM closed_counts ORDER BY closed_count DESC LIMIT 1
),
qualifying_cities AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s."XCL_050" AS city
  FROM schools s
  WHERE s."XCL_045" = (SELECT county FROM top_county)
    AND s."XCL_044" = 'Active'
    AND s."XCL_069" = 'District Community Day School'
)
SELECT s."XCL_050" AS city,
       CAST(SUM(f."XCL_025") AS REAL) / SUM(f."XCL_024") AS free_meal_eligibility_rate
FROM frpm f
INNER JOIN schools s ON f."XCL_001" = s."XCL_041"
WHERE s."XCL_050" IN (SELECT city FROM qualifying_cities)
GROUP BY s."XCL_050"
